ApiKeyAuth.description: Send the header `Authorization: ApiKey <username>:<api_key>`. Generate an API key from your CommCare HQ account settings.
ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization

BasicAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication with a CommCare HQ username and password.

DigestAuth.description: HTTP Digest authentication with a CommCare HQ username and password.

get.description: Fetch, create and update cases. GET returns a page of cases matching the given filters, or a single case when a case ID is given. POST with a single JSON object always creates a new case. POST with a list performs a bulk change: each item creates or updates a case according to its own "create" field, or is upserted by external_id when "create" is omitted. PUT to the case ID or external ID in the URL updates that case; PUT to the external ID URL is a genuine upsert, creating the case if none exists with that external ID. PUT to the list URL (no ID in the path) instead identifies the case via a case_id/external_id field in the body, and requires the case to already exist -- it is not an upsert.

parameters.description: Return cases with this case name.
parameters.name: case_name

parameters.description: Return cases of this case type.
parameters.name: case_type

parameters.description: Return only closed (true) or only open (false) cases.
parameters.name: closed

parameters.description: Filter by the date the case was closed.
parameters.name: date_closed

parameters.description: Filter by the date the case was opened.
parameters.name: date_opened

parameters.description: Return cases with this external ID.
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.description: Include cases whose case type is deprecated.
parameters.name: include_deprecated

parameters.description: Filter by the date the case was indexed for search.
parameters.name: indexed_on

parameters.description: Return cases indexed by the given case, as indices.<identifier>=<case_id>.
parameters.name: indices

parameters.description: Filter by modification date, as last_modified.gte=<date>.
parameters.name: last_modified

parameters.description: Return cases owned by this user or group ID.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: Filter by case property, as properties.<name>=<value>.
parameters.name: properties

next.description: Present only when more records match than were returned; pass its "cursor" value back as a query parameter to fetch the next page.

oneOf.description: Creates a new case. Requires case_name, case_type and owner_id, like a single-object POST.

Updates an existing case. Must include either "case_id" or "external_id" to identify the case (JsonCaseUpdate.validate() enforces this at runtime, though neither is individually required by this schema, since either satisfies it).
Upserts a case by external_id: updates it if a case with that external_id already exists, or creates it otherwise.

post.description: Fetch multiple cases by case ID and/or external ID in a single request. The body must include "case_ids" and/or "external_ids" (both may be given together). Unlike GET /a/{domain}/api/case/v2/<case_id>,<case_id>,..., this has no practical limit on how many cases can be requested at once.
